images.caption: Figure 2:Overview of the WikiSkill framework.The agent workspace is structured into three layers: immutable execution traces (Raw Layer), a persistent knowledge base that compounds across iterations (Wiki Layer), and active procedural instructions (Skills Layer). In each evolutionary loop, the Inference Agent runs rollouts (injecting active skills but restricting Wiki access), the Wiki Maintainer consolidates traces into the Wiki, and the Skill Proposer (with the ReAct mechanism) suggests updates while the Wiki is retained across all iterations.

Figure 3:Case study of Wiki-guided skill evolution on ALFWorld (Qwen-3.6-27B). The persistent Wiki Layer compiles cross-iteration patterns, an audit trail of past proposal diffs and acceptance decisions, and chronological history. Informed by the rejection of the skill proposal at Iteration 0, the proposer synthesizes the accepted skill update at Iteration 1, and later refines it with new pattern evidence. File contents are simplified for clarity.
